transcript: Speaker A: The Guardian just published an article called 'The end of typing?'. They're saying workers are getting voicepilled. Sounds insane because it's basically what happened to me. Build me a budget tracker. Actually, no, make it a saving goals app. I want to set a target amount, log deposits, and see a progress bar that fills up as I get closer. The entire prompt, I just said it. No typing, no editing, no formatting. If you haven't been voicepilled yet, this is your sign. Download Wispr Flow, it's free.
on_screen_text: The end of typing? Why workers are suddenly ditching their keyboards. Wispr Flow. Download for Free.
summary: The presenter introduces 'voicepilling' from a Guardian article and demonstrates Wispr Flow by dictating a complex prompt. She highlights the ease of voice dictation over typing and invites users to download the app for free.
